mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION R JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS LB ON R.lbidx = LB.lbidx JOIN BOOKS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx JOIN USER U ON R.uidx = U.uidx WHERE R.delyn IN ('N', 'Y')

SELECT R.ridx, B.coverImg, B.title, B.author, B.publisher, LB.callName, U.name, U.userNumber, R.pickupDate, R.status FROM RESERVATION R JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS LB ON R.lbidx = LB.lbidx JOIN BOOKS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx JOIN USER U ON R.uidx = U.uidx WHERE R.delyn IN ('N', 'Y')
ORDER BY R.ridx DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N'

SELECT B.coverImg, B.title, B.author, B.publisher, LB.lbidx, LB.code, LB.callName, LB.location, LB.dueDate, LB.status FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N'
ORDER BY LB.lbidx LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum};
SELECT pickupDate FROM RESERVATION WHERE lbidx = #{lbidx} AND delyn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE RESERVATION SET status = '예약취소', delyn = 'Y' WHERE ridx = #{ridx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOAN WHERE lbidx = #{lbidx} AND dueDate >= CURDATE()

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.startDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(o.endDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate FROM OVERDUE o JOIN `USER` u ON o.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND o.status = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION (lbidx, uidx, reservationDate, pickupDate, dueDate, status) VALUES ( #{lbidx}, (SELECT uidx FROM `USER` WHERE userNumber = #{userNumber}), #{reservationDate}, #{pickupDate}, #{dueDate}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE LIBRARYBOOKS SET status = '예약대기' WHERE lbidx IN ( SELECT lbidx FROM RESERVATION WHERE DATEDIFF(pickupDate, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 )
